design_standard: Each level uses a deliberately different logical structure inspired by the variety observed in the user-provided workbook examples; no puzzle text or answer is copied.
difficulty: Beginner includes direct footholds; Easy adds arithmetic; Medium emphasizes rank/spec relationships; Hard uses indirect cross-category identity clues; Expert uses a multi-day chain with no direct day assignment.
app_features: Version 10 game layout, Apple Pencil marking, progress bar, transitions, themes, hints, solved state and celebration preserved.
